svg.aria-label: Topographic iso-tone contour study of a Lambertian sphere: closed level lines of the n-dot-L field crowding toward the terminator.
svg.text: MARK SYSTEM: iso-tone level lines, n·L exact plane-sections — 13 levels · 25 arc runs / 5089 vertices · stroke 0.50–0.75px · axial pitch 3.1–38.9px (tightens to terminator) · L=(-0.55,-0.69,0.46)
